rules: All task IDs are unique; dependency IDs exist and contain no cycle.
A task is selectable only if dependencies are verified or reviewed and its contract version is current.
Verified means task checks pass, not that the project is independently reviewed.
No verification command is trusted until the foundation validates it in the actual environment.
Every required project outcome must map to at least one task and acceptance case.
Changing a contract invalidates affected task evidence until rechecked.
